entries.en: Excuse me, Commander Shepard? Could you spare a moment of your time?
Greetings, and welcome to the Presidium. My name is Avina, and I am pleased to be your virtual guide throughout this level of the Citadel space station.
I am a fully interactive virtual intelligence, programmed to provide spontaneous guidance at predetermined locations of interest throughout this level of the Citadel.
I may also be contacted through any of the Presidium VI terminals, should you require assistance.
You are standing at Presidium Tourism Terminal I. On either side of this lobby are the embassies of the various Citadel races, along with C-Sec headquarters.
What does that mean?
Tell me about the embassies.
What can you tell me about the Citadel Council?
Goodbye.
Our records indicate this is your first time on the Citadel. A brief orientation session is customary. Please allow me to do my job.
I apologize if you found my service unsatisfactory. Please submit any complaints in writing to the Citadel Tourist and Visitor Board. Have a nice day.
Welcome to Presidium Tourism Terminal I. There are many points of interest here, including the Citadel Embassies and C-Sec headquarters.
On the far end of this level you can see the Citadel Tower, where the Council meets regularly to discuss matters of interstellar importance.
Each species in Citadel space important enough to be consulted on matters of galactic politics maintains an embassy on the Presidium.
The volus were the first non-Council species to be granted an embassy, roughly 2,384 galactic standard years ago. As Citadel space has expanded, more embassies have been added.
The most recently added embassy belongs to your own species: humanity. It was added nineteen galactic standard years ago, despite some rather vocal opposition.
In the early years following the formation of the Council the volus were--apart from the asari and salarians--the most populous and widespread species in Citadel space.
They established many new colonies and trading outposts, and they petitioned the Council for a greater role in determining interstellar policy.
In recognition of their work to expand interstellar trade and establish a standardized galactic economy, the volus were granted an embassy here on the Citadel.
The Council races have extensive responsibilities. They must provide personnel and ships for the Citadel fleets. They often provide economic aid in times of disaster.
It would be unfair to demand such an enormous burden of a species unable to meet these obligations. The embassies allow lesser species to have a voice on the Citadel.
I apologize if my personality has offended you. Please submit all formal complaints in writing to the Citadel Tourist and Visitor Board.
Goodbye, and thank you for using Avina. Please enjoy your visit to the Citadel.
I don't need a guide.
I'll pass.
How come the volus were the first species given an embassy?
Why weren't they made a Council race?
That's pretty damn arrogant!
Why were people trying to keep my species out?
Some species felt humanity was given preferential treatment. It often takes a century or more before a new species is granted an embassy.
The Council gave a great deal of thought to this matter. In the end, they decided humanity's impact on Citadel space was significant enough to warrant an embassy.
I am not programmed to make that kind of qualified judgment. My code is limited to information and simple interaction simulations.
Originally, the Council consisted of representatives from the asari and salarians, the two dominant species in Citadel space.
Since then, the three Council races have worked together to ensure the peaceful coexistence of the galactic community, while preserving individual autonomy for each species.
I am not programmed to make that kind of qualified judgment. My code is limited to information and simple interaction simulations.
Do you agree with their decision?
It can't be as simple as that. There must be problems somewhere in the system.
Embassies
What do you think?
Sounds too perfect.
Virtual guide?
No, thanks.
Not interested.
Citadel Council
Log off.
Why were the volus first?
Why was humanity opposed?
Just an embassy?
Lesser species?
The term Spectre is derived from the branch of Special Tactics and Reconnaissance. Each Spectre agent is hand-picked by the Council.
Their primary role is preserving galactic stability and resolving volatile situations that cannot be handled through normal political channels.
In this role, they are granted extraterritorial rights and jurisdictions. Spectres answer to no law or authority except the Council itself.
Citadel Security serves as law enforcement for all regions of the Citadel, though the majority of officers serve in the wards.
Executor Pallin, a turian, is the current head of C-Sec, but individuals from virtually every species across Citadel space serve as officers beneath him.
If you wish to learn more, Executor Pallin's office is located in the C-Sec headquarters just across the lobby.
Roughly 1,304 galactic standard years ago, turians were invited to join the Council in recognition of the role they played during the Krogan Rebellion.
Do you know anything about Spectres?
I want to know more about Citadel Security.
So are you a person or a program?
Give me the tour.
Spectres
C-Sec
Are you real?
Sounds interesting.
Are you real?
Welcome to the Presidium. Allow me to be your guide.
Look at that bug thing over there. What's it doing?
Please do not disturb the keepers.
Good day, Commander. The human ambassador is up the stairs, first room on the right.
My name is Saphyria. I am the administrative assistant for the embassies.
This is the Presidium. More specifically, you are at the Citadel Embassies.
If you have more questions, please access Avina.
Have a pleasant day.
Is there something else I can help you with, Commander?
What's your name? What do you do here?
What is this place?
I should be going now.
Personal question
Location
Goodbye.
The embassies are the hub of all Citadel politics. When you represent trillions of citizens it tends to get a little busy.
Oh, Avina is the virtual guide for the Citadel. Feel free to access the terminal yourself.
You seem to be distracted.
What's that?
Busy?
Avina?
Yes. I receive reports on all newly arrived dignitaries and notable people.
You know who I am?
Commander?
Have we met?
Hello again, Commander. Has there been any word?
Thank you. I will return home and begin my preparations.
This isn't about them! This is about my wife, the woman the military killed!
You think I have not given enough? Do not speak to me of duty! My wife is dead!
Yes she is, Mr. Bhatia. She died fighting for what she believed in.
She sacrificed her life to keep you safe. I think she'd want to make the most of that sacrifice.
You are right, Miss Williams. She would not flinch from her duty.
I just want her to come home. I miss her so much.
Let them run their tests. Let my wife save lives, so that others are spared the loss I feel today.
Goodbye. Thank you for finding me answers.
Commander Shepard? My name is Samesh Bhatia. Forgive the intrusion, but I have nowhere else to turn.
My wife was a marine. She was in the 212 on Eden Prime.
Wait. The 212? Your wife was Serviceman Nirali Bhatia? I'm Gunnery Chief Ashley Williams. I served in her unit.
Chief Williams. It is a pleasure. Nirali spoke of you with great respect.
I'm so sorry for your loss, Mr. Bhatia. Nirali was a good woman. What can we do for you?
The 212? Isn't that Ashley's unit? She might want to meet Mr. Bhatia.
I've requested that my wife's body be returned to me for cremation, but the military has refused my request.
I don't know. All I know is that they have declared it impossible for my wife to be returned to me.
Mr. Bhatia, rest assured that we will avenge your wife's death. We're dealing with the people who attacked Eden Prime.
I understand. You have many important things to do.
If you do have time, however, Mr. Bosker is the man in charge of my case. He is in the expensive bar over there.
The man in charge of my case is Mr. Bosker. When I last saw him, he was in the expensive bar over there.
Thank you for your time. I just want to give my wife a proper funeral and the respect she deserves.
It does not bring me happiness, but it may bring me peace. Goodbye, Commander.
Samesh? I don't know if this helps, but your wife.... Nirali loved you very much.
She missed your cooking, and she played recordings of you every night before she went to sleep.
I know, Miss Williams. But thank you. It is nice to hear it again.
Mr. Bhatia, I'm Ashley Williams. I served with your wife in the 212. I wanted to tell you how sorry I am.
Gunnery Chief Williams? My wife spoke of you with great respect. Thank you.
Has any progress been made with Mr. Bosker? Will he return my wife's body?
Hello, Commander. Has any progress been made with Mr. Bosker? Will he return my wife's body?
He was in the expensive bar over there.
As I said, I have been told nothing. I don't understand why they won't release her body to me!
Thank you, Commander.
Yes, you told me as much. I don't care what the military wants for her!
My wife finished her service when she gave her life on Eden Prime. It is time for her to come home.
Tests? They are holding my wife's body for tests?
My wife served the Alliance faithfully. She gave her life for humanity! And this is how they repay her?
Thank you. Please let me know what can be done.
Nirali always said that the military sticks together. Why should this be any different?
I knew my wife might one day give her life for the military. I did not think you would take her body as well!
I know those tests are important, Commander, but we could have found another way.
We could have found another way.
What right does the military have to hold her body? She has already given her life!
It doesn't matter! She's dead!
Your wife is coming home, Mr. Bhatia.
I reminded Mr. Bosker what we're fighting for. Your wife is coming home.
Where can I find this Mr. Bosker?
Tell me again what you'd been told about your wife.
Not yet. I'll be back when I have more to tell you.
They're running medical studies on Nirali. That's why they won't release the body.
It's not as simple as I'd hoped. The military needs your wife's body for important tests.
It's unacceptable. I'll let you know what I can do.
I'm not going to go against the military, Mr. Bhatia. I can't help you.
The dead stay dead, Chief. We have to focus on the living.
It had to be done, Chief. You know that.
Mr. Bhatia, your wife died defending humanity. We still need her help.
She died a hero, Mr. Bhatia. And now she has a chance to save even more lives.
If the military had asked your wife to submit to tests to save human lives, what would she have said?
Samesh, right now, more people are going to die unless the military runs those tests.
The geth killed your wife. And they'll kill a lot more if we don't run those tests!
This is war! People die! If you want to keep that to a minimum, let them run those tests!
What do you need?
A lot of people want my help these days. What makes you special?
It's no trouble. What can I do for you?
Why did they refuse your request? There's got to be some reason.
We'll look into it.
There's no reason for your wife's body to be held like this. Just wait here.
I'm concerned with the living, not the dead. I don't have time for this.
I can put in a word with the embassy and speed things along.
It's done.
I took care of it.
She's coming home.
Bosker's location
Wife
Goodbye.
They're running tests.
There's a problem.
We'll fix this.
We'll fix this.
I'll work on it.
I'm done with this.
This is important.
This is war.
I'm sorry.
It was the right decision.
We had no choice.
She did it willingly.
She can still help.
What would she want?
Lives are at stake!
The military didn't kill her.
Wake up, Samesh!
I'm listening.
What is it?
I'm happy to help.
That's garbage.
Did they say why?
Let me help.
I'll find out.
We'll put this right.
This is pointless.
